The Future of Social Commerce: State of Consumer 2026 🚀

We were delighted to welcome more than 200 guests to TikTok Shop HQ in London for our State of Consumer 2026 event! Hosted in partnership with HSBC Innovation Banking and Boots UK, the energy in the room was absolutely electric as we brought together founders, investors, retailers, and industry leaders to unpack how modern brands are built, backed, and scaled.

At TikTok Shop, our mission is to redefine the intersection of content, community, and commerce. Listening to insights from our ecosystem partners proved that the future of retail is dynamic, omnichannel, and happening right now. As our partners at Boots put it, the evening was the ultimate masterclass in taking community-driven consumer connection "From URL to IRL".

The night truly came alive with an incredible line-up of fast-paced product pitches and a bustling live sampling zone. It was amazing to experience the pure innovation on display from game-changing brands like Living Things Soda, MOJU, The Beard Struggle, Rocco, ByErim, BoobyBiome, Karri, Jude, Saicho Sparkling Tea, GRIP Hair, SULT™, and MÀNO X MNRL. 💥

Thank you to all of our panelists, speakers & partners!

Ed Gilmartin, Grace Vernon, John Stewart, Nicole Scola, Anna Walker, George Meagher, Illya Symonenko, Rahul Berry, Priyanka Hariharan, Lauren Mathurin, Una Kent, Charlotte Lock, Lucy Irving, Dan Turner, Angela Chou, Courtney S., Taymoor Atighetchi, Kirsty Macdonald, Guy Hayler, Ian Gill, Estia Ryan, John Collins, Oli Hills, Rob Tripp, Nikolas Venios, George Kelly
